decisions.reason: As a finned tube for air coolers it is tightly related to our existing heat-exchange knowledge base and manufacturing capabilities, and its continued standalone presentation beyond launch suggests enough learning and market fit to justify further exploitation and incremental improvement.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes build directly on our core engineering and R&D competences, so under an absorptive-capacity logic we are well placed to refine and commercialize them using service feedback, research links, and their stronger persistence versus the other 2018 launches.
